crossRefs.note: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
For I say through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than…
In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that…
If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
Do all things without complaining and arguing,
I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

translations.web: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.
translations.bsb: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
translations.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
translations.asv: And there arose a reasoning among them, which of them was the greatest.
